verdict.rationale: Brevo's developer docs say contact lists can be imported, updated, and organized programmatically, which covers the list-management core of the story. Segments appear only as a product feature on the pricing page, with no API evidence, and nothing shows reading back list or segment membership. Missing for 10: documented API for creating/updating segments or tags, documented endpoint to read back exact list/segment membership, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can create and update segments, tags, or lists programmatically and read back exactly who is in them

citations.quote: Import, update, and organize your contact lists programmatically.
Create as many segments as you need.
